name: parity_engine_eval
description: 25 binary assertions for Parity Engine — score calculation, HTML generation, gap detection, platform comparison

assertions.desc: KPI_DATA contains exactly 45 entries (37 PropZone features + 8 ZoneWise advantages)
calcScore() returns done=12 matching PropZone features confirmed in ZoneWise
calcScore() returns partial=12 features with partial ZoneWise coverage
calcScore() returns gaps=13 features PropZone has that ZoneWise lacks
calcScore() returns advantages=8 ZoneWise-only features
calcScore() pctDone equals Math.round(done/37*100) = 32%
calcScore() pctWithPartials equals Math.round((done+partial)/37*100) = 65%
generateHTML() returns string longer than 50KB (rich self-contained dashboard)
generateHTML() contains <!DOCTYPE html> and </html> (valid HTML document)
generateHTML() contains no external CDN URLs (http:// or https:// in script/link/img src tags)
generateHTML() contains all 4 brand colors: #1E3A5F #F59E0B #22C55E #EF4444
generateHTML() contains 4 filter buttons: done, partial, gap, advantage
generateHTML() contains inline SVG score rings (circle elements with stroke-dasharray)
generateHTML() contains all 3 views: KPI Matrix, Checkpoint Roadmap, Pipeline
generateHTML() contains all 5 checkpoints CP1–CP5 with status indicators
generateHTML() contains pipeline SVG with nodes for PropZone Intel, ZoneWise, Parity Engine
generateHTML() data-status attributes present on all table rows (done/partial/gap/advantage)
generateHTML() data-priority attributes present on rows with P1/P2/P3 gaps
cmdGaps() outputs P1 items including: Description, Overlays, Max Built Area, Max Units, Permitted Uses
cmdScore() output shows 32% done and 65% with partials
cmdCompare('ZoneWise','PropZone') shows ZoneWise winning aiCapabilities dimension
cmdCompare('ZoneWise','PropZone') shows PropZone winning dataCoverage dimension
cmdExport() writes parity-latest.html to docs/reports/ directory
PLATFORM_DB contains 4 platforms: ZoneWise, PropZone, Reonomy, CoStar
--help prints all 5 commands: dashboard, score, gaps, compare, export
